papers.title: Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization
papers.summary: The paper proposes a unified framework for work agents that integrates foundation models with runtime harnesses to execute complex digital tasks reliably, introducing dimensions of persistence and openness alongside capability families and evaluation metrics.

papers.title: Qwen-Image-PE: Learning Visual Design for Text-to-Image Prompt Enhancement
papers.summary: Qwen-Image-PE improves text-to-image prompts via two-stage training with caption-based reverse distillation and groupwise design rewards, scaling across data, model size, and information density.

papers.title: Extreme Compression of Per-Layer Embeddings via Cross-Layer Latent Vector Quantization
papers.summary: OPTIC achieves extreme compression of per-layer embeddings by using token-shared indexed codes and layer-specific affine decoders fitted to the output path, preserving most model performance at up to 1000x compression with minimal inference overhead.

papers.title: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
papers.summary: StreamVibe introduces a benchmark, streaming vision-language model, and hierarchical memory harness to enable proactive, intent-aware interaction with implicit and evolving user goals.

papers.title: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
papers.summary: Trajectory2Gym improves tool-use training by constructing interactions with compositional coverage and decision grounding rather than collecting successful trajectories.
